result.topic_en: Pencil calculations: in the upper part, a perturbation-series solution in powers of g of a second-order differential equation with coefficients involving $\Theta(\lambda)$ and $(\lambda-5)$; in the lower part (written sideways), elliptic-type integrals of $(p\cos^2u+q\sin^2u)$ with $p=(1-\rho)/(1+\rho)$, and a related Fourier-type expansion.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial (\lambda-5)\frac{\partial u}{\partial e}}{\partial e}$ [-$+ g$-] $\frac{g\,6\,p}{(\lambda-5)^2}\,u = 0$ [?]
$u = 1 + g\lambda + g^2(\lambda^2 + a_{2,1}\lambda + a_{2,2})$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\lambda}$ [?] $\Theta(\lambda)\frac{1}{2}(\lambda-5)\,\Theta'(\lambda)$
$p_0 = \frac{1}{2}(\lambda-5)\,\Theta'(\lambda) - \Theta\lambda$
$(\lambda-5)\,\Theta(\lambda)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\lambda^2} + \left(\frac{1}{2}\Theta'(\lambda)(\lambda-5) - \Theta(\lambda)\right)\frac{\partial u}{\partial\lambda} = g\,p\,u$
$\left((\lambda-5)\,\Theta(\lambda)\frac{\partial^2 u_n}{\partial\lambda^2} + \left(\frac{1}{2}\Theta'(\lambda)(\lambda-5) - \Theta(\lambda)\right)\frac{\partial u_n}{\partial\lambda}\right) g^n = g\,p\sum g^\nu u_{n-1-\nu}\, g^{n-1-\nu}$ [?] $= g^n\left(u_0 p_{n-1} + u_1 p_{n-2} \cdots + u_{n-1} p_0\right)$

$\frac{1}{\lambda-5}\,\Theta\lambda^2\left(\frac{1}{(\lambda-5)^2}\Theta\lambda + \frac{1}{\lambda-5}\frac{1}{2}\Theta'\lambda\right)$ [?]
$u = u_0 + u_1 g \cdots$
$p = p_0 + p_1 g + p_2 g^2 \cdots$
$(\;) = u_0 p_1 + u_1 p_0$ [?]
[-...-]
$\frac{\partial^2 u_2}{\partial\lambda^2} = 2\lambda + \beta$ [?]
$u_1 = \lambda$
$\frac{1}{2}\lambda(\lambda-5)\,\Theta'\lambda - \Theta\lambda\,\lambda$
$2(\lambda-5)\,\Theta(\lambda)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\lambda^2} + (2\lambda+\beta)\frac{1}{2}\Theta(\lambda)(\lambda-5)$ [?]

$u\frac{\partial u'}{\partial\lambda} - u'\frac{\partial u}{\partial\lambda} = \ldots$ [?]

$\sqrt{(1-\rho^2\sin^2\varphi)(1-\rho\ldots)}$ [?] $= a_0 + 2\sum(-1)^\nu a_\nu \cos 2\nu\varphi$ [?]
$p = \frac{1-\rho}{1+\rho}$ $\quad q = \frac{1-\rho_1}{1+\rho_1}$
$\frac{\pi}{2}\,a_\nu = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{(p\cos^2u + q\sin^2u)^\nu}{\sqrt{(1-p(p\cos^2u+q\sin^2u))(1-q(p\cos^2u+q\sin^2u))}}$ [?]
$\frac{\pi}{2}\,a_\nu = \sum_{\mu=1}^{\mu=\infty} \ldots$ [?]
$c_m = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (p\cos^2u + q\sin^2u)^m\, du$
$\left(\frac{p+q}{2}\right)^m\left(1 + (m)_2\,\ldots\right)$ [?] $\quad \varrho = \frac{\sqrt{p}-\sqrt{q}}{\sqrt{p}+\sqrt{q}}$
$\int \frac{d\varphi}{\sqrt{1-\ldots}}$ [?]
$-\int_0^x \varphi(t)\ldots$ [?]
